notes.title: [Update] BATTLE STEED : GUNMA official launch update
notes.content:
Hello. This is BATTLE STEED : GUNMA Development Team.

Finally, BATTLE STEED : GUNMA has been officially released on Steam in August 11, 2022.

During the early access period, we were able to find and fix the problems and make the game better.
We will do our best to upgrade the game by receiving opinions from gamers even during the official service.

In the official release version, the following updates were made:

----------------------------------------------------------

1. [Official launch schedule]
 - August 11th AM 10:00 KST

2. [Change the price on official Release]
 - FREE

3. [Official release updates]
 - Initialization of play data, such as combat records, levels, etc.
 - maximum number in the battle changed
  : All Battle mode changed to 5 vs 5 Battle
 - Playable Maps (existing 2 Maps are Optimized and 4 new Maps are added)
  : Redwood Point / Nuclear Arsenal / Hidden Lab / Hidden Lab: Night War / Military Base / Military Base: Full Moon / Futures Park (Training Ground)
 - Playable battle mode
  : Quick Match (Greed mode / Capture mode)
  : Ranked Battle (Greed mode / Capture mode): Added
  : A.I. Practice Match (Capture mode): Aadded
  : Training Field
 - Changed the robot's arms and special skills
 - Improved Game Sound (BGM and Battle Sound Effects, etc.)
 - Overall Graphic renewal of Robots, Maps, SFX, etc
 - Add the Premium Skin for Robot
 - Other Bug Fixes and system improvements

4. [Reward for early access users]
 - The target
  : Paid buyers before August 11, 10:00 AM KST
 - Reward details
  : Rank Pass + Premium Skin(SP-23 Advanced Type Skin) + 17,000 M-COIN

5. [Others]
 - Hold Group(party) System updates
  : Additional development required.

----------------------------------------------------------

We are reading all the comments from the community.
Please give us a lot of feedback about BATTLE STEED : GUNMA.

Thank You

notes.title: [Notice] About the official release of BATTLE STEED : GUNMA
notes.content:
Hello. This is BATTLE STEED : GUNMA Development Team.

Since the launch of "Early Access" on Steam on August 26, 2021,
We have made Updates and Bug Fixes that reflect user's opinions.
But we thought we couldn't satisfy users by continuing a small update.
So we wanted to meet users with additional development.

We apologize for not notifying you in advance.

Now we can proceed with the official service with the update.

----------------------------------------------------------

1. [Official launch schedule]
- August 11th

2. [Change price on official launch]
- Switching from Paid to Free game

3. [Official release updates]
- 4 New Maps
- New Ranked Battle mode
- New A.I. Practice Mode
- Improved game sound (In-Game Musics and Sound Effects)
- Enhanced Graphics
- New Skins for Robots
- Group system(Will be updated soon)
- Other Bug Fixes and system improvements

In addition, we will reward users who have purchased the game on Early Access.

------------------------------------------------------------
We are preparing for an official release based on the above updates.
If the schedule or content changes, we will notify again.

Thank you for waiting.

notes.title: [Patch note] Sound Fixes and Bug Patches (November 18, 2021 16:00 KST)
notes.content:
This is the BattleSteed development team.  
The following items have been added/fixed in this patch. 

[b]1. The skills of ES-37 have been reworked.[/b]
- FireSupport (E-skill): Summons a drone that attacks with the main weapon.
- Deceleration Missile (Q-Skill): Fires a missile in front, dealing damage and reducing movement speed.
- Domination (ultimate): Activates a drone that can explore a wide area.(After a certain amount of time, the drone disappears.)
   While the ultimate is active Skills change to Cluster Missile(E-skill) and EMP Missile(Q-skill).
  - EMP Missile(E-Skill): Fires a missile with a slight guidance function to deal damage and stun the enemy.
  - Cluster Missile(Q-Skill): Fires a howitzer missile that spreads from the peak and deals wide-area damage.

[b]2. Balance related fixes[/b]
- The attack power of the ES-37's main weapon has been reduced.
- DP-99 Fatal Missile's bullet recovery speed has been increased.
- The extra time duration when capturing Area has been reduced.

[b]3. UI Fixes[/b]
- In-game text has been changed to be more readable.
- Fixed to make it easier to see key controls in the training area.
- UIs that teach beginners how to operate have been added.

[b]4. Other fixes[/b]
- SFX of some skills have been improved. (It is constantly being improved.)
- The visual presentation of some skills has been improved.

And some minor bugs have been fixed.

We always appreciate your feedback.

thank you.

notes.title: [Patch note] System Fixes and Bug Patches (October 7, 2021 16:00 KST)
notes.content:
This is the BattleSteed development team.  
The following items have been added/fixed in this patch. 
 
[b]1. Sound related fixes.[/b]
- Weapon firing sound effects for some robots have been changed. (AH-64, ES-37, T-80, SP-23)
- A bug in sound effect attenuation has been fixed (weapon sound, hit sound, and explosion sound). Bugs may still remain.
- Fixed a bug where multiple sounds were not output properly.
- You can now see the direction and location of the enemy more clearly with the sound of the weapon.

[b]2. Other fixes.[/b]
- The robot's jumping and landing animations have been changed.
- Fixed a bug where DP-99's Fatal Missile would reduce the sprint gauge of a hit robot.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes did not reload.
- The bug where the reload cancel punch of the T-80 did not work has been fixed.
- Now there are several types of training dummy in the training area.

And some minor bugs have been fixed.


In addition to today's patch, we're working on weapon sounds for other robots, as well as other sound effects.
Since there have been many comments about the sound part, we are working on it with more effort, and will continue to improve it.

We always appreciate your feedback.

thank you.

notes.title: [Patch Note] System Fixes and Bug Patches (September 16, 2021 16:30 KST)
notes.content:
This is the BattleSteed development team.  
The following items have been added/fixed in this patch. 
 
[b]1) Training area [/b]
- Improve UI and sound to give the same shooting experience as the game 
- close the training area after a certain period of time 
- Add a item for level-up test 
- Add training dummy action (gun shooting) 
 
[b]2) Add Winning screen [/b]
- Show Winners and Player of the match
 
[b]3) Fix errors in each map[/b] 
- Corrected parts that should not be climbed or digging into 
 
[b]4) Animations of some machines have been changed.[/b]

[b]5) Balance adjustment[/b]
- Now all machines can use melee attacks while reloading. (Reload is canceled when using melee attack)
- Damage increase per level of NT-01 has been reduced.
- The projectile acceleration of the DP-99's Fatal Missile(E Skill) has been increased.

[b]6) Other patches[/b]
- Shortened the respawn time of the practice mode(the practice time before the start of the main game) 
- Changed to receive a kill medal even if the enemy machine is destroyed during the practice mode. (only medals, no kill points)
- In greed mode, even when the number of each team is small, you can get the same amount of money as when you have 6 players by default so that the progress of the game does not slow down. 

------------------------------------------------------------ 
 
In addition, we are working on the following content.
 
[b]1) Sound update [/b]
- Update of sound (weapon, hit, movement, etc.) 
- Sound volume attenuation bug will be fixed 
- In-game BGM will be available 
 
[b]2) Improve machine animation [/b]
- Replace the current motion with a motion more suitable for the machine (mainly for movement) 
 
[b]3) Balance adjustment [/b]
- Weapon and skill damage adjustment 
- Fix Damage and type for Some skills 
 
[b]4) Enhance help during games [/b]
- Add UI to view the rules of each mode during the game 
- Add UI to check keyboard mapping layout 

[b]5) Party play [/b]
- Add Steam friends and friends you met in the game to your party so that you can play as a team during the game 
 
[b]6) Add a new machine [/b]

notes.title: [Patch Note] System Fixes and Bug Patches (September 3, 21 16:00 KST)
notes.content:
1. To improve control responsiveness, now some skills can be used immediately during reload and sprint 
 
[Applied to the skills below] 
 1) DP-99 : Assault (Q Skill), Impregnable Shield (Z Skill)   
 2) T-80 : Stealth (E Skill), Smoke Shell (Q Skill), Carpet Bombing (Z Skill)   
 3) MR-17 : Repair Bomb (E Skill), Repair Drone(Q Skill), Equipment Ascend (Z Skill)   
 4) GA-75 : Detection Drone (E Skill), Avengers (Z Skill)   
 
2. A multiple kill system has been added.  
   - Now you get a higher score for killing enemies in a row. 
 
3. Now You can also get score when capturing areas 
 
4. Now you can practice with opponents while waiting for other players. 
 
5. Now you can get 'Kill Assist' when enemy is killed by Missile launch pad. 
 
And some minor bugs are fixed
